documentation.hyperStatFactor: Per-cycle compounding factor for mob health/damage and the boss escalation
documentation.speedPerStack: Additive mob movement speed per HYPER stack (0.2 = +20%)
documentation.bossHealthPercent: Boss base escalation as a fraction of base health (50 = +5000%), multiplied by hyperStatFactor^cycle
documentation.bossDamagePercent: Boss base damage escalation, same shape as bossHealthPercent
documentation.bossStatIncrement: Boss-exclusive linear bonus added per cycle on top of the exponential (15 = +1500%/cycle)
documentation.bossAbilityHaste: Rune 'haste points' for the boss's shield/waveblast abilities (vanilla rune roll is 0-3)
documentation.baseRuneTier: Rune count at cycle 0 (keys the shield/waveblast settings table)
documentation.runeTierCap: Rune count ceiling so deep cycles cannot index past the config
documentation.playerScaleBossHealth: Extra boss max health per EXTRA runner (0.5 = duo x1.5, trio x2.0); excluded from the loot score
documentation.chaosPerKill: Chaos modifiers dumped per boss kill (and once when the vault starts)
documentation.chaosCap: Total chaos budget for the whole vault (dumps, ambient events and brutal kills all draw from it)
documentation.ambientPeriodTicks: Ticks between ambient negative modifier pulls (one per runner per period)
documentation.wavePeriodTicks: Ticks between timed brutal waves during the boss fight
documentation.healthGates: Boss health fractions that each trigger one extra brutal wave (order = persisted gate bits; do not reorder mid-vault)
documentation.fightAddPeriodTicks: Ticks between lone tank/assassin arena adds during the fight
documentation.exitPillarTicks: Lifetime of the post-kill exit pillar
documentation.winTransitionTicks: Personal victory countdown after clicking the exit pillar
documentation.obeliskMin/obeliskMax: Brutal pillar count range; the floor rises +1 per 3 kills and +1 per 2 extra runners
documentation.brutalObeliskProbability: Per-room chance the brutal mini claims a room's objective anchor
documentation.elixirTargetMultiplier/elixirTargetIncre: Elixir target = base x (multiplier + increment x cycle)
documentation.cycleRequirementIncrement: Card requirements grow this fraction of base per boss kill
documentation.boardUpsizeCycle: Cycle at which bingo/collector boards grow to 5x5
documentation.playerScaleElixir/playerScaleBingo: Requirement scale per EXTRA runner (the collector keeps VH's native +50%)
documentation.speedCapFactor: Final mob movement speed is capped at base x this (2.5 = +150%)
documentation.referenceBossHealth/referenceBossDamage: Boogeyman level-100 bases; scores apply the killed boss's multipliers to these so every roster boss scores identically
documentation.scoreRare/scoreEpic/scoreOmega: Kill scores that add one rare/epic/omega crate-injection marker (non-exclusive)
documentation.scoreDoubleGreedy/scoreTripleGreedy: Kill scores that raise the greedy crate tiers granted per kill to 2 / 3
documentation.scoreExtraDraw: Epic/omega markers earned at or above this score roll one extra draw per set
documentation.crateTierScore7/9/15: Kill k grants 5k regular crate tiers, 7k/9k/15k once the kill scores past these
documentation.greedBonusTierEfficiency: The per-crate greed bonus rolls at crate quantity x this in hyper vaults (coins excluded)
documentation.greedyCoinBonusPerStack: Extra greed coins in the completion crate per greedy crate tier stack (1.0 = +100%)
documentation.rareRolls/epicRolls/omegaRolls: Draws per marker stack from each injection pool
documentation.rareRewards/epicRewards/omegaRewards: The injection pools: item+count(+weight), or a boosterPack/deckCore/greedCoins/randomEtching special
